allocator.noFree: 0x181979096..0cc: if freeHead0 choose nextUnused, expand capacity if full, increment nextUnused.
allocator.returnedRef: 0x1819790e1 writes selected index;0x1819790e3..0ef rawVersion=((oldVersion+1)&0x7fffffff)|0x80000000;0x1819790f6 returns 64-bit {index low32,rawVersion high32}. Preserve raw version bits; do not invent generation1 or normalize to dense indices.
allocator.destroy: Frame.Destroy0x181977de8 sets pending flag2 in entry+8; CommitDestroys0x1819795a6..5c3 links entry.index=oldFreeHead, sets freeHead=destroyedIndex and increments freeCount. Destroy request is not immediate index recycling. Component removals/swap order remain commit dependent.
